newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's Horizon sees falling H1 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's Horizon sees falling H1 earnings.

text.p: Hungarian research and development company Horizon-Multiplan said on Friday that a slump in sales and other factors would substantially depress the firm's results.
Horizon-Multiplan said in the Budapest Stock Exchange's (BSE) official gazette that in the first five months of the year the company's economic indicators were unfavourable.
It added that an internal investigation about the company's activities was underway and it had already unveiled problems.

"A set of problems -- a substantial fall in domestic and exports sales, the deficiencies of financial and sales control and a bill unpaid by Hoffman Schneider Capital S.A. -- influence the result's of Horizon-Multiplan's operations fundamentally," the company said.

The directors will discuss the report of the company's adviser about the investigation on June 27 and by June 30 they will publish their plans, which will detail the measures to be taken and also name the persons who are responsible for the problems, Horizon-Multiplan said.
The statement did not disclose if the company suspected any criminal offence.
It added that Horizon-Multiplan expected its Humet anti-cancer product to create new markets for the company.
Horizon-Multiplan closed at 190 forints on the BSE on Thursday, and was untraded on Friday.
